skills.name: issue-triage
skills.purpose: First-pass triage of one newly opened Electron issue. Use when asked to triage an issue. Runs the deterministic checks, then decides a component label, whether to ask for an Electron Fiddle repro, whether an earlier issue reports the same problem, and whether the report belongs elsewhere (security, a third-party app, a website, Chromium/Node, a usage question). Output is at most one add_labels call and one triage_comment call, or a noop.
